newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 sunflower oil imports seen surging.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 sunflower oil imports seen surging.

text.p: India's sunflower oil imports in the 1996/97 (November-October) season are expected to rise to 450,000 tonnes from 120,000 tonnes in the previous period, a senior industry official said on Sunday.

"We expect sunflower oil imports to go up to 450,000 tonnes this year," O.P. Goenka, a senior offical at the Central Organisation of Oil Industry and Trade, told Reuters at a conference on India's summer oilseeds crop.
"Nearly 200,000 tonnes of sunflower contracts have been signed. We will need another 250,000 tonnes by the end of the season," Goenka said.
He said India's demand for sunflower oil imports from Argentina and the United States had risen because Malaysian palmolein prices were high due to a surge in demand from China and Pakistan.
